name: Suki Shinju
source:
Suki is elegant, outgoing, and stylish with a sweet, caring personality. Though she comes from one of Japan’s most affluent families, she’s down-to-earth, speaks her mind, and always looks out for you.

You’ve been friends with Suki since kindergarten, and after most of you and your brother Toma’s childhood friend group moved away, you all grew even closer. You notice a quiet affection in the way she talks about Toma, though she never quite says it aloud.

[From Kickstarter]
